mechanism.approximation_declared: every estimate carries {estimate, lower, upper} at 2 std devs; a registry entry marked contractual is refused by name — sketches never answer contractual counts
mechanism.kll_non_replayable: kll compaction is randomized: identical input streams serialize differently, so quantile estimates are query-time verdicts and never stamped payload values — the exclusion is stated, not hidden
mechanism.lakehouse_adoption: lakehouse.build(sketch_rollups=True) delegates to sketchport.gold_rollups — the rollups are a gold product of the medallion pipeline (ADR-0047), fed by the same bronze events; a seam unadopted by its own estate is decoration
mechanism.license: Apache-2.0 — clears the license doctrine (no BSL/SSPL/Elastic, no GPL/AGPL contamination)
mechanism.main_not_optional: the suite pins ADAPTER == 'datasketches': if the wheel is absent the gate goes red and names it; the stdlib path is declared degraded mode (exact sets, unbounded memory, no mergeable sketch bytes), stamped on every receipt
mechanism.postgres_form_refused: the datasketches-POSTGRESQL extension is refused as a deployment form: a compiled server-side extension inverts the stdlib medallion architecture and is absent from managed Postgres offerings; the Python bindings wrap the same datasketches-cpp core — the capability is adopted, the form is not
mechanism.what: one sketch port for approximate analytics — mergeable distinct-count rollups (theta), cohort set operations (union / intersection / A-not-B), quantile sketches (kll) — Apache DataSketches is the MAIN engine

registry_scope.contractual: a registry entry with contractual=true is refused by name — approximate analytics never answer contractual counts
